title: The Tower That Grows
hook: The Eiffel Tower grows 15 centimetres every summer.

characters.name: Guide
characters.look: a tour guide in a navy coat

beats.say: Gustave Eiffel's company built it in just over two years, for the 1889 World's Fair.
beats.see: the tower half built, cranes on top

beats.say: Scientists say iron towers will outlast stone ones by 400 years.
beats.see: rust on a girder, then a stone bridge

beats.say: Every seven years, sixty tonnes of paint are brushed on by hand.
beats.see: painters on ropes high on the tower

beats.say: It was the tallest structure in the world until 1930. Today it is a symbol of Paris.
beats.see: the tower over the rooftops at dusk

beats.say: Nobody can say how long it will stand.

lines.text: More than 300 million people have visited it.

beats.see: the guide at the foot of the tower, the crowd behind her
